lastFeatureSummary: Shipped v0.5.9: migrated all three maps (Map Explorer, Species Detail, Statistics) from Leaflet + raster tiles to MapLibre GL + OpenFreeMap vector tiles via a shared <SnowMap> wrapper; full atlas parity (grid, breeding shading, block click popup, hatch textures, shading-priority dimming of heatmap/pins); centralized the heat model in lib/heat.ts; removed Leaflet entirely. Batched two fixes into the same release: Breeding Codes species-name left-align, and the Life List Total media count now links to all media. Tester added heat.test.ts + mapStyle.test.ts (299 frontend / 90 backend green); Auditor clean (0 vulns; JSX popups). Deployer published GitHub release v0.5.9 — notarized macOS universal DMG + signed Windows installer + latest.json (caught + fixed a tauri.conf.json version lag mid-release). Chronicler updated CLAUDE.md (MapLibre conventions + bump-both-version-files rule) and DECISIONS.md.
